diagrams.title: From Attack to Indicator
diagrams.subtitle: Click each step to see the definition and exam takeaway.

nodes.label: Attack
nodes.detail: An attack always leaves traces: files, network, credentials, logs.
nodes.exam: The vector is not the attack: it is the entry path.

nodes.label: Traces
nodes.detail: Files, processes, connections, DNS queries, timestamps.
nodes.exam: An isolated trace is not proof: correlate sources.

nodes.label: IOC
nodes.detail: Indicator of Compromise: specific, shareable data used to detect or block.
nodes.exam: A hash/IP is an IOC; a TTP is more durable.

nodes.label: Detection
nodes.detail: Correlation of IOCs with rules and enrichment.
nodes.exam: False positives outnumber true positives: tuning is essential.

nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.detail: Qualify the incident: attack family, scope, severity.
